description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core controller named StatsController that provides an API endpoint to retrieve and process grain statistics from an Orleans cluster, including grouping by silo address and handling specific conditions based on the number of silos.

classes.name: StatsController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core API controller that provides an endpoint to retrieve silo statistics from an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: SiloData
classes.description: A record type representing silo host information and activation count.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves grain statistics, groups them by silo address, modifies the data based on specific conditions, and returns the data as an API response.
